caption: popcap's coin-grabbing descent - pop groups of coins, bank the money bag, dodge the explosions.
about: Big money! deluxe is popcap's coin-clearing arcade: matching groups of coins pop off the board, the moneybag at the bottom pays out when it reaches the bank, and bombs and power-ups keep every descent different. The post-office-minigame break between levels gave the loop a second rhythm, and the whole thing runs on the same one-hand reflex logic as the studio's biggest hits.
The steam listing is the deluxe build still sold under popcap's ea-era catalog, so this one never went dark. It remains the best coin game of the portal era and the cheapest smile on this shelf.
